name: lrc-401
description: Lebanese Red Cross — Saida 401: inventory, equipment reporting and access management
//: Root package: it owns NO application code. It only orchestrates the two real packages (server/ and client/) so that everything can be run from one place, as a single `npm run dev`.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm run db:generate
scripts.dev:client: node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm --prefix client run dev
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
